title: HALO II: Constraining Hubble constant $H_{0}$ through continuum delay fitting of Fairall 9
summary: The Hubble tension remains one of the most significant unresolved problems in modern cosmology. A key question is whether it may arise from underestimated systematic uncertainties in the different measurement techniques. In this context, new independent methods are of exceptional importance. We therefore pursue a novel approach to determining the Hubble constant, $H_{0}$ based on continuum time delay and spectral energy distribution (SED) modeling in active galactic nuclei (AGNs).
